pages.text: Mouse was looking for a new house.
pages.action: Mouse sets out to find a new house
pages.change: Mouse is introduced as homeless and searching

notes: night landscape of rolling patterned hills; a single small lit house on a far hill; Mouse is a tiny figure in the bottom corner
illustration.only_in_image: Mouse is tiny against a huge night landscape (scale); the one house on the hill is planted as the destination; it is already night.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.text: This looks like a nice house.
pages.action: Mouse stops at a heavy door standing ajar
pages.change: Mouse finds a house that looks right
pages.question_created: Who lives here, and will Mouse be welcome?

notes: close-up of a heavy wooden door ajar; Mouse sits at the gap, whiskers twitching, a sliver of light inside
illustration.only_in_image: The "house" is a human home: Mouse slips in through the gap of a big door; his nose twitch shows he is hopeful.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.text:
"You can come and sleep with me," said Puppy.
"Thank you," said Mouse.
pages.action: Puppy offers his bed; Mouse thanks him
pages.change: Mouse accepts a first place to sleep
pages.question_created: What will sleeping with Puppy be like?
pages.page_turn_note: the spread ends on the thanks; the result of the night is held for the next spread

notes: round vignette: a huge black dog head and paw fill the right; tiny Mouse stands up, tail raised, facing the tongue
illustration.only_in_image: Puppy is enormous next to Mouse; Mouse greets him upright and unafraid, tail lifted.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.text: That night, Mouse's dreams were bouncy and muddy.

notes: full-bleed brown woven basket texture; Mouse curled in the middle, motion strokes around his head
illustration.only_in_image: The bed is the dog's straw basket; the strokes around Mouse show he is bounced about in his sleep.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.text:
"You can come and sleep with me," said Parrot.
"Thank you," said Mouse.
pages.location: inside the house, by the perch
pages.action: Parrot offers his place; Mouse thanks him
pages.question_created: Can a mouse sleep on a perch?
pages.page_turn_note: same offer-and-thanks frame; the reader can predict trouble

notes: round vignette: a red, green and blue parrot leans down from a high wooden perch; Mouse looks up at it
illustration.only_in_image: Parrot's bed is a perch high up, which a mouse cannot grip; the picture lets the reader predict the bad night.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.text: That night, Mouse's dreams were noisy and wild.
pages.action: Mouse tumbles through a wild night
pages.change: The second bed fails, worse than the first

notes: dark jungle of orange and green leaves; Mouse falls upside down, legs splayed, mouth open
illustration.only_in_image: Mouse is falling head first, the perch has thrown him; the dream takes the shape of the parrot's jungle.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.text:
"You can come and sleep with me," said Fish.
"Thank you," said Mouse.
pages.location: inside the house, by the fishbowl
pages.action: Fish offers his home; Mouse thanks him
pages.question_created: A mouse sleeping with a fish?
pages.page_turn_note: the most predictable of the three offers: the picture of water makes the next result obvious

notes: round vignette of pale water; Mouse seen from behind faces an orange fish
illustration.only_in_image: Fish's home is water; Mouse is shown from behind, so his face (and doubt) is hidden.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.text: That night, Mouse's dreams were cold and wet.
pages.action: Mouse spends a cold, wet night
pages.change: The third bed fails; the pattern of failure is complete

notes: dark teal underwater scene with weeds and patterned fish; Mouse hunched and curled tight on a rock
illustration.only_in_image: Mouse is shown under water, curled tight and hunched against the cold; the dream is the fish's world.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.text: Mouse needed somewhere warm and dry.
pages.action: Mouse runs off to find his own place
pages.change: Mouse stops accepting offers and decides for himself

notes: orange patterned wallpaper; Mouse runs low and stretched along the skirting board, a small determined smile
illustration.only_in_image: Mouse acts alone and fast: the running pose and smile show determination the text does not state.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.action: Mouse sits on the sofa back facing the fire
pages.change: Mouse finds warmth: the household fire
pages.question_created: Where will Mouse sleep near the fire?
pages.page_turn_note: wordless spread between two text spreads; the warmth is shown before it is named

notes: wordless double spread: an arched fireplace with flames; dark silhouettes of the human family on a blue sofa; Mouse, lit warm, sits on the sofa back
illustration.only_in_image: The source of warmth is the human family's fire; the people are silhouettes and do not notice Mouse; Mouse is the only lit figure.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.question_created: Where is Mouse on the shelf?

notes: a row of patterned book spines on a shelf against a pale wall; Mouse is not visible
illustration.only_in_image: Mouse is not in the picture at all: he has hidden himself among the books; the gaps between spines invite the reader to look for him.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.text: That night, Mouse had warm and cosy dreams.
pages.change: The search is over; the dream is good
pages.page_turn_note: the fourth "That night" spread, now positive

notes: warm red-orange glow; Mouse curled on a shelf edge; cheese wedges and hearts float in the dream
illustration.only_in_image: The good dream is of cheese and hearts, a mouse's own wishes rather than a host's world; the fire's colour fills the page.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.action: The narrator says good night to Mouse

notes: single small round vignette on white: Mouse sitting on the patterned hill from the cover and the opening spread
illustration.only_in_image: The closing vignette repeats the cover image of Mouse on the patterned hill: a visual return to the start, small and quiet.
